title: imp/{site}/change/{head_id} payload
description: UPSERT payload of imp/{site}/change/{head_id}: a change an import made on the figure, with its undo (import.proto WHAT AN IMPORT DOES WITH A DECISION): applied (only MFC changed it), favor_app or favor_mfc (a conflict the user's preference settled). Answered with undo or dismiss; a tombstone means none. Serialized, at most 3,205,521 bytes of UTF-8 as JSON.stringify writes it. Server-owned: a Push of this key is REJECTED facet_key_not_user_owned.

import.description: The per-user counter of the import that made it.

copies.description: The copies' writes, in occ-id order. At most 500 per figure.

items.description: One copy's writes: each property present is written to occ/{occ}/{property}; a status of "removed" is a tombstone.

status.description: Its status, or "removed" for a tombstone.

head_id.description: Its figure, written with the first status of a copy the import creates, or on ROW MOVED.

collection.description: Its filing, as FILING resets it to {status}/default.

origin.description: The origin the write gives a copy the import creates (occ-origin.schema.json).

site.description: The source's site key, e.g. mfc.

native_id.description: The source's id for the row's item, canonical (for mfc, canonicalMfcId: no leading zeros).

ordinal.description: Which of the row's Count copies, 1 to 99.

fields.description: The figure values' writes. At most 24 per figure.

items.description: One figure value written under one head: the value is the property the `field` names; none is a tombstone.

head_id.description: The head written under (rule 6's write target, or every head holding it for a tombstone).

score.description: The score, when field is score.

note.description: The note, when field is note.

wishability.description: The wishability, when field is wishability.

undo.description: What undo would write: the values before, or for favor_app what take writes now.
